LU_GU_ZHEN_REN_CARDPILE_GU_CARDS.title: Gu Hand
LU_GU_ZHEN_REN_CARDPILE_GU_CARDS.descrip: The Gu Hand holds up to 5 usable Gu Worms. When space is available, Gu enter from the Gu Storage Pile in cooldown-completion order. Killer Move deduction can use only Gu in the Gu Hand. Gu Worms can be played directly from here.
LU_GU_ZHEN_REN_CARDPILE_GU_DISCARD.title: Gu Cooldown Pile
LU_GU_ZHEN_REN_CARDPILE_GU_DISCARD.descr: Stores only Gu that are still cooling down. After a Gu spends all available activations it enters this pile; when cooldown completes it returns to the Gu Storage Pile, then enters the Gu Hand in order. Left-click to inspect.
LU_GU_ZHEN_REN_CARDPILE_GU_DISCARD.empty: The Gu Cooldown Pile is empty.
LU_GU_ZHEN_REN_CARDPILE_GU_SEALED.title: Sealed Gu Pile
LU_GU_ZHEN_REN_CARDPILE_GU_SEALED.descri: Holds Strength Gu that have not finished training this combat, plus Gu Worms sealed into Killer Moves. Play their permanent companion cards to train them; at full progress they unseal into the Gu Hand. Materials return to the Gu Cooldown Pile when the Killer Move is consumed or dismantled.
LU_GU_ZHEN_REN_CARDPILE_GU_CARDS.selecti: Select Gu Worm materials matching the selected Killer Move, then confirm.
LU_GU_ZHEN_REN_CARDPILE_GU_CARDS.targetS: First select the Killer Move to deduce. Only matching materials will be shown next.
LU_GU_ZHEN_REN_RECIPE_COMPENDIUM.title: Recipe Compendium
LU_GU_ZHEN_REN_RECIPE_COMPENDIUM.descrip: Browse every Killer Move deduction and Gu refinement recipe.
LU_GU_ZHEN_REN_CARDPILE_GU_STORAGE.title: Gu Storage Pile
LU_GU_ZHEN_REN_CARDPILE_GU_STORAGE.descr: Stores Gu that have completely cooled down and are waiting to enter the Gu Hand. When the Gu Hand has room, they enter in cooldown-completion order; ties use a stable order. Left-click to inspect.
LU_GU_ZHEN_REN_CARDPILE_GU_STORAGE.empty: The Gu Storage Pile is empty.
